meta.title: DeAltura Coffee — High-altitude Latin American coffee, roasted in Canada
meta.description: Wholesale specialty coffee from Santa Cruz de Mora, in the Andes of Mérida, Venezuela, roasted in Canada for cafés and shops.

hero.lead: Specialty coffee from the Andes of Mérida, Venezuela, roasted every week in Canada for cafés, restaurants and shops.
hero.meterLabel: Altitude where each origin grows, compared with Toronto

intro.heading: Altitude is flavour
intro.note: In the cool air of the Andes the cherries ripen slowly. Slow ripening makes denser beans with more sugar: cane sugar, caramel and walnut in the cup.

facts.explain: Above sea level, in the Andes of Mérida
Specialty grade, verified by an SCA cupping

moments.caption: Washed and dried
moments.text: The fruit is washed away and the beans dry slowly in the sun before milling.

moments.caption: Shipped green

moments.caption: At your counter

items.a: Cafés, restaurants, shops and offices in Canada with a business account. Apply once and we review it within two business days.
{kg} kg per order, in any mix of formats and roasts.
Every Tuesday. Orders placed by Monday at noon go into that week's roast and ship within 48 hours.
The same beans with three roast curves. Light for filter, medium for almost everything, dark for espresso with milk. You choose the roast for each line of your order.
Across Canada by courier. Delivery is free from {free} kg; below that it is a flat {flat}.
By card at checkout. Approved accounts can ask to be invoiced on net 30 terms.

items.q: Do you charge tax on coffee?
items.a: Roasted coffee beans are basic groceries in Canada, so they are zero-rated for GST and HST.
Whole bean only, so the coffee stays fresh until it reaches your grinder.

items.q: Where does the coffee come from?
items.a: From Santa Cruz de Mora, in the Andes of Mérida, Venezuela. Every lot is traced to its farm and analysed in a lab before it ships.

origin.title: Santa Cruz de Mora
origin.lead: A coffee town in the Andes of Mérida, Venezuela.
origin.whyText: High in the mountains the nights are cold and the days are mild. Cherries take longer to ripen, beans grow denser, and the cup gains sweetness and structure. That is the whole idea of DeAltura: coffee from up high.
origin.canadaText: We bring the coffee in green and roast it here, close to the cafés that serve it, so every bag reaches you within days of roasting.
origin.allLead: Each lot sits where it grows. Toronto, where the coffee lands, is at 76 m.

mar.noCost: To calculate margins, log at least one purchase and one roast so we know what each kilo costs.
mar.how: How it's calculated: cost of coffee = kg sold × average cost per roasted kg of that roast (green coffee with freight and customs + roaster + supplies). Profit = sales + shipping − cost of coffee − the month's operating expenses. Income tax not included.

about.title: Who we are
about.lead: We bring coffee from the Venezuelan Andes to Canadian counters, roasted fresh every week.
story: DeAltura started with a simple idea: the coffee grown in the mountains of Venezuela deserves a place in Canada's cafés.
We work with growers in Santa Cruz de Mora, Mérida. We import their green coffee, roast it here every week and deliver it to cafés, restaurants and shops across the country.

pillars.title: From the farm
pillars.text: We know who grows every lot: the producer, the farm and the altitude. That story travels on the bag.

pillars.title: Verified in the lab
pillars.text: Every lot is analysed before it ships. Our current lot from Finca La Curva scored 84 SCA points, specialty grade.

pillars.title: Roasted in Canada
pillars.text: Green coffee keeps for months, so we roast here each week. Your coffee reaches you within days of roasting.
